name: Yelp

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - a HackerRank-style OA then 2-3 back-to-back technical interviews, one often with a manager rather than only peer engineers
rounds: Technical interview (~45 min) with a software engineer
2 further back-to-back technical interviews (~45 min each): one with a software engineer, one with a manager
Later stages for some pipelines: deeper technical tests plus reference and personality-style assessments
extraTopics: LeetCode-style problems delivered via an online link/interview platform, with a real-time follow-up conversation
Being ready to discuss "why Yelp" and a proudest project across multiple rounds, not just once

ladder.title: Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer

sources.title: Glassdoor: Yelp Software Engineer interview reports (co-op, Mexico City, London)
used: HackerRank challenge then 3 back-to-back technical rounds including a manager round; LeetCode-style online interview format

rolesNotes: Only one source page was reviewed (aggregating several independent candidate reports) - treat the loop shape as one documented pattern, not broadly cross-verified. Level naming beyond "Software Engineer" is not confirmed by the source reviewed.
